system.description:
Strange Check against a Ghost's CR (p182) to convince it to help you. On a success it acts as your companion for the Combat Encounter. Doom +3 per Combat Round the Ghost is present.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.67
system.summary: Strange Check against a Ghost's CR (p182) to convince it to help you. On a success it acts as your companion for the Combat Encounter. Doom +3 per Combat Round the Ghost is present.

automation.onSuccess: The Ghost is your companion for the rest of the Combat Encounter.

when.label: Each Combat Round the Ghost is with you

automation.note: A Ghost must be present (standard Ghost p182: CR 1, 16 HP; change the CR for other ghosts). Tick Doom +3 every Combat Round it stays.
